discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch. Updated the test to send the request as `Provider: schemas.Anthropic` while the override sets `Provider: schemas.OpenAI`. Anthropic is registered with a sentinel server that must never be called; OpenAI is absent from static config and gets auto-inited by the override. The test now actually exercises the dialect switch path.

This is intentional design. The `ClearValue` + conditional re-set pattern serves two purposes: (1) it clears any leftover from a previous attempt so retries start clean, and (2) it enforces that `req.Update*` methods are the only supported path for injecting overrides. Direct `ctx.SetValue(BifrostContextKeyProviderOverride, ...)` calls during a hook are explicitly documented as unsupported in `context.go` (comment on `reservedKeys`), and the `ClearValue` is what makes that contract hold. The `Update*` API covers every override case (key, base URL, provider, base provider type), so there is no legitimate reason for a plugin to write to this context key directly.

Good catch
Fixed. Model extraction is now gated on `/v1/` prefix + `Content-Type: application/json`, so admin routes and multipart uploads are skipped entirely.

This narrows the wire contract: a non-object value at the nested `text.format.schema.schema` position (wrapped `{name, strict, schema: true}` shape) decoded and was forwarded on dev, and now fails the whole request decode with `orderedmap: expected '{'`. The top-level `"schema": true` case already failed before, so the blast radius is just the wrapped shape with a boolean/scalar schema - fine to accept, but then let's note it under breaking changes.

Follow-up rather than this PR: this spread branch duplicates `ResponsesTextConfigFormatJSONSchema.ToMap()` but emits only 8 of its ~24 fields - `items`, `enum`, `anyOf`/`oneOf`/`allOf`, `$ref`, `definitions`, `format`, `pattern`, and the min/max constraints are silently dropped from schemas sent to Gemini (pre-existing, this PR just had to touch both spreaders). Calling `ToMap()` and layering the two gemini extras (`title` from `Name`, `propertyOrdering`) on top would close the gap, though it changes behavior and deserves its own tests.

Fixed - `Schema` is now `*JSONSchemaOrBool` (mirroring the existing `AdditionalPropertiesStruct` bool-or-object pattern), so boolean JSON Schemas (`"schema": true` / `"schema": false`) decode and forward again, and object schemas keep key order. Non-schema scalars (strings/numbers) still fail decode with a clear error. See updated code.

Intentional. Raw-body passthrough (`bifrost-use-raw-request-body`) is sent to the provider as-is by design — the request builder only rewrites scalar routing fields (model / max_tokens / stream / anthropic_version) and never transforms message content, so URL inlining is deliberately skipped on this path. A url-source image/document in a raw-body request is the caller's responsibility to inline; Bifrost will not rewrite the passthrough body. The typed (non-raw) path still inlines URLs for Vertex/Claude.
